cap_setuid: Can change process UID; especially sensitive on interpreters and general-purpose binaries.
cap_setgid: Can change process GID and group credentials.
cap_dac_override: Bypasses ordinary file read, write, and execute permission checks.
cap_dac_read_search: Bypasses file read and directory search permission checks.
cap_sys_admin: Broad kernel and system administration authority.
cap_sys_ptrace: Can inspect or control other processes subject to kernel policy.
cap_sys_module: Can load or unload kernel modules.
cap_setfcap: Can assign file capabilities to files.
cap_net_raw: Can use raw and packet sockets; may enable traffic capture or crafted packets.
cap_fowner: Can bypass ownership checks for operations such as permission changes.
cap_linux_immutable: Can change immutable and append-only file attributes.
